drafts.rationale: EV-K-A1 defines a distinct per-job cap on total delivery attempts, including the first attempt.
drafts.subject: Delivery job

drafts.rationale: EV-K-B1 specifies a required wait after a failed attempt before any retry starts.
drafts.subject: Delivery retry

drafts.rationale: EV-K-N1 states what must happen when a job still has not succeeded after its last permitted attempt.
drafts.subject: Delivery job

drafts.rationale: EV-K-A1 states each delivery job may make no more than three delivery attempts in total, and that the first attempt counts toward that limit.
EV-K-B1 states the worker waits five seconds after the preceding failed attempt before starting any retry.

drafts.predicate: action after last permitted attempt fails
drafts.rationale: EV-K-N1 requires leaving a job that failed its last permitted attempt in failed state for operator review and forbids automatically discarding it.

value.text: leave the job in failed state and require operator review; do not automatically discard

drafts.rationale: EV-K-A2 states each delivery job's original attempt plus allowed additional retries, which is the same locus as the job's maximum delivery attempts.
drafts.subject: Delivery job

drafts.rationale: EV-K-A2 allows one original delivery attempt plus up to three additional retries, so the maximum total is four attempts.

drafts.reason: EV-K-A2 corrects the live total from three attempts to one original plus three retries (four total), so the prior quantity of three is no longer accurate.

drafts.rationale: EV-K-A3 limits a job to one initial delivery attempt plus at most three retries, which is the same maximum-attempts locus as ADDR-41301eebc689f79c.
drafts.subject: Delivery job

drafts.rationale: EV-K-A3 restates one initial delivery attempt plus no more than three retries after failure, which is the same four-attempt maximum already claimed.
EV-K-B2 specifies how long to wait before retry attempts, including an initial wait, doubling thereafter, and a thirty-second cap. That is the same locus as Delivery retry / Wait before retry.
drafts.subject: Retry wait

drafts.rationale: EV-K-B2 states retry waits are not fixed: two seconds before the first retry, doubling before each later retry, capped at thirty seconds.

value.text: Not fixed: two seconds before the first retry, then double the previous wait before each later retry, never more than thirty seconds

drafts.reason: EV-K-B2 replaces the fixed five-second wait with a non-fixed exponential backoff policy at the same wait-before-retry locus.
